answer: A zenith of per-task receipts records who did what, and the quill of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, reduced by each unverified claim, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Reaching the orchard of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
